Intel Items.facts: Anthropic raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital. Post-money valuation: $965 billion. Round was co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners, GIC, ICONIQ, and XN. Includes $15 billion of previously committed investments from hyperscalers, including $5 billion from Amazon. Run-rate revenue crossed $47 billion earlier in May 2026.

Anthropic raised $30 billion in Series G funding led by GIC and Coatue. Post-money valuation: $380 billion. Round was co-led by D.E. Shaw Ventures, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ, and MGX. Includes portion of previously announced investments from Microsoft and NVIDIA. Run-rate revenue was $14 billion at time of announcement.

Anomalies.description: Multiple sources (Facebook/Meta AI summaries, some news articles) reference funding rounds and valuations dated in mid-to-late 2026 (e.g., August 2026, valuations of $1+ trillion). These appear to be speculative or hypothetical content, as the officially confirmed most recent funding round is the Series H announced May 28, 2026 at $965 billion valuation. No official announcements or credible financial reporting confirms any funding rounds after May 28, 2026.

Search results contained references to a $350 billion valuation in some January 2026 reports, which later was reported as $380 billion in the official February 12, 2026 announcement. This appears to have been pre-announcement speculation or preliminary reporting that was superseded by the official $380 billion figure.

Cluster 1 - Timeline Identification.findings: Most recent funding round: Series H closed May 28, 2026. Previous round: Series G closed February 12, 2026. Series F closed September 2, 2025.

Cluster 2 - Valuation Figures.findings: Series H (most recent): $965 billion post-money valuation. Series G: $380 billion post-money. Series F: $183 billion post-money.

Cluster 3 - Round Participants and Struc.findings: Series H ($65B): Led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, Sequoia Capital; co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners, GIC, ICONIQ, XN. Includes $15B prior hyperscaler commitments ($5B from Amazon). Series G ($30B): Led by GIC and Coatue; co-led by D.E. Shaw Ventures, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ, MGX.

Cluster 4 - Context and Verification.findings: Valuation progression: $61.5B (March 2025) → $183B (September 2025) → $380B (February 2026) → $965B (May 2026). Multiple independent sources (CNBC, TechCrunch, Crunchbase) confirm Series G and H figures. No conflicting reports on most recent round valuation.
